name: RATE_ILIM_P
comment: Roll integrator clamp; the anti-windup is this clamp and nothing subtler

name: RATE_ILIM_Q
comment: Pitch integrator clamp; the anti-windup is this clamp and nothing subtler

name: RATE_KI_P
comment: Roll-rate loop integral gain; demand per radian of integrated rate error

name: RATE_KI_Q
comment: Pitch-rate loop integral gain; demand per radian of integrated rate error

name: RATE_KP_P
comment: Roll-rate loop proportional gain

name: RATE_KP_Q
comment: Pitch-rate loop proportional gain

name: RATE_KP_R
comment: Yaw-rate damper gain; there is no yaw integrator because heading is not held

name: STAB_COORD_GAIN
comment: Turn coordination: fraction of the coordinated yaw rate g sin(phi) cos(theta) / V added to the yaw-rate setpoint when the airspeed is valid; 0 is a plain damper

name: STAB_KP_PITCH
comment: Pitch attitude loop gain; rad/s of rate setpoint per rad of pitch error

name: STAB_KP_ROLL
comment: Roll attitude loop gain; rad/s of rate setpoint per rad of bank error

name: STAB_MAX_BANK
comment: Bank angle commanded at full roll stick in STAB; 0.698 rad is 40 degrees

name: STAB_MAX_PITCH
comment: Pitch angle commanded at full pitch stick in STAB; 0.349 rad is 20 degrees

name: STAB_PITCH_TRIM
comment: Pitch attitude commanded with the pitch stick centred in STAB: the trimmed theta, from the trim solve at the canonical condition

name: STAB_YAW_RATE
comment: Yaw rate commanded at full yaw stick in STAB; between sticks the damper holds the coordinated turn rate (STAB_COORD_GAIN) or zero

name: TRIM_MOM_L
comment: Feed-forward roll moment demand holding the trim; the roll integrator holds the rest

name: TRIM_MOM_M
comment: Feed-forward pitch moment demand holding the trim (the closed-loop trim's pitch demand through MIX); the pitch integrator holds the rest

name: TRIM_MOM_N
comment: Feed-forward yaw moment demand holding the trim; yaw has no integrator, so this is the only yaw trim there is
